svg.aria-label: 2D ligand interaction map surrounded by labelled protein sites
svg.title: MK1: protein–ligand contacts
svg.desc: Protein residue structures surround the ligand. R marks continuation into other residues. Straight dashed lines join individual atom or ring pairs. Small gaps separate crossing contact strokes; distances in tooltips come from 3D coordinates.
